Blondies, Infinitely Adaptable

Blondies, Infinitely Adaptable

  • Servings: 16 or more
  • Time: 40 minutes
  • 8 tablespoons (1 stick) unsalted butter
  • 1 cup light or dark brown sugar
  • 1 large egg
  • 1 cup all-purpose flour
Heat oven to 350°F. Butter an 8x8-inch baking pan.

Melt butter, whisk in sugar, egg and flour. Pour into pan and bake for 20 to 25 minutes.
